[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] QTS Data Centers, formerly QTS Realty Trust, is a large scale data center provider. Per Blackstone Real Estate Income Trusts own press release, Blackstone affiliated funds completed a roughly 10 billion dollar acquisition of QTS Realty Trust on August 31, 2021, taking the company private. This specific row is one of four entries in this registry all named QTS Data Center - Hillsboro 2, clustered within about 400 meters of each other. Unlike this operators Fayetteville or Ashburn Lockridge campuses, this campus has genuinely distinct per-building addresses: DataCenterMap listings, fetched fresh this session, give DC1 at 4755 NE Huffman Street, DC2 at 4425 NE Huffman Street, DC3 at 4327 NE Huffman Street, and DC5 at 4113 NE Huffman Street, all in Hillsboro, OR. None of the four rows in this registry carry a DC number to disambiguate them, and this session had no precise geocoding tool available to match each rows coordinates to a specific Huffman Street house number. No specific address is asserted for this row.
